answer_1.quote: We introduce a framework for focus-level evaluation of LLM reviews, which systematically analyzes where the reviews direct their praise and criticism based on facets considered important in peer review

answer_2.quote: We measured Kullback-Leibler (KL) Divergence between the focus distributions of the models and human experts. We also measured F1 scores over the set of annotated (target, aspect) pairs as an agreement on review points. For text similarity, we measured ROUGE-L, BERTScore, and BLEU-4 between the LLM and expert reviews.
